title: Gateways

entry.unused: This gateway has been offline for more than 7 days. Is it no longer in use? Then revoke it.

warnings.certExpiring: The certificate expires in {{ days }} days.
warnings.certExpiringSoon: The certificate expires in less than a day.
warnings.certExpired: The certificate has expired. The gateway can no longer connect.
warnings.crlExpiring: The revocation list expires soon. Renew it on your own computer (where the CA is) with “pki.sh crl” and distribute it with “broker-certs.sh”.

revokedHint: The gateway is revoked in the app. Now revoke its certificate too with “pki.sh revoke” and distribute the revocation list with “broker-certs.sh”; only then will the broker turn it away.

empty.title: No gateways yet
empty.description: An owner of the household connects Home Assistant with a code under “Pair Home Assistant”. A platform administrator registers Zigbee2MQTT gateways with their certificate; the steps are in the “Gateway” runbook.

register.title: Register a gateway
register.name: Name
register.nameError: Please enter a name of at most 60 characters.
register.certificateHint: The text of the certificate, including the BEGIN and END lines. Never paste the private key.
register.certificateError: Please paste the certificate (at most 20,000 characters).
register.privateKeyError: This looks like a private key and was not sent. Only the certificate (the public part) belongs here; the key stays on the gateway.

pairing.title: Pair Home Assistant
pairing.intro: A code connects a Home Assistant instance to this household. The code is valid for 15 minutes and works once.
pairing.waiting: Waiting for Home Assistant. Enter the code there.
pairing.address: Address of this app (to enter in Home Assistant):
pairing.step1: Install the “Smart Home” integration through HACS and restart Home Assistant.
pairing.step2: Open Settings, Devices & services and add the “Smart Home” integration.
pairing.step3: Enter the address of the app and the pairing code.

repair.step1: In Home Assistant, open Settings → Devices & services → Smart Home and remove the entry. Devices and readings in this app are kept.
repair.step2: Add the “Smart Home” integration again and enter the address of the app and this code.
repair.reauth: If Home Assistant already offers to re-authenticate “Smart Home”, enter the code there instead.
repair.open: Add the integration in Home Assistant again
